---
name: Development task
about: A focused, testable unit of work
---

## Outcome

What can a user do after this change?

## Scope

Describe the smallest coherent implementation and exclusions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable behavior
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation

## Dependencies

Link prerequisite issues and assign the appropriate milestone.

## Implementation boundaries

Link the roadmap key and relevant decision record. Identify domain/service,
persistence, UI, and documentation work only where needed. Specify legacy data
handling and what must remain unchanged. List explicit non-goals.

## Validation and evidence

List concrete input/output examples and important edge cases. For visible
changes, name the screens, themes, keyboard interactions, and screenshots needed.
State what makes this issue complete without implementing its follow-up issues.
